blocks.text: O'zbek tilida vaqtni bitta qo'shimcha bilan aytamiz: soat sakkiz**da**, dushanba**da**, aprel**da**, 2020-yil**da**. Ingliz tilida esa shu bitta `-da` o'rniga **uchta predlog** bor: **at**, **on**, **in**. Qaysi biri kerakligi vaqtning «hajmiga» bog'liq: aniq nuqta (soat) — **at**, bitta kun (sana, hafta kuni) — **on**, uzunroq davr (oy, yil, fasl, asr) — **in**. Yana bir farq: o'zbekcha qo'shimcha so'zdan **keyin** qo'shiladi (sakkiz**da**), inglizcha predlog esa so'zdan **oldin** turadi (**at** eight).

rows: soat yetti**da**, ikki yarim**da**, yarim tun**da**
oy, yil, fasl, asr, uzun davr

blocks.text: **at** soatdagi aniq nuqtani ko'rsatadi: **at** six, **at** 9.30, **at** noon (tush payti), **at** midnight. «Soat nechada?» (What time ...?) savoliga javob deyarli doim **at** bilan boshlanadi. Bundan tashqari bir nechta turg'un ibora ham **at** oladi: **at night** (kechasi), **at the weekend** (dam olish kunlari), **at Christmas** (Rojdestvo bayramida), **at the moment** (hozir), **at the same time** (bir vaqtda), **at the end of** / **at the beginning of** (... oxirida / boshida). Ularni qoida bilan emas, tayyor ibora sifatida eslab qolgan ma'qul.

items.text: I'm afraid Bekzod is busy **at the moment**.

blocks.text: **at the weekend** — British English. Amerikada **on the weekend** deyiladi. Bizning kitobimiz British English bo'yicha, shuning uchun **at the weekend** ni ishlating.

**on** bitta butun kun bilan keladi: hafta kunlari (**on** Friday), sanalar (**on** 21 March), maxsus kunlar (**on** my birthday, **on** New Year's Day, **on** Independence Day). Harakat har hafta takrorlansa, kun nomi ko'plikda bo'ladi: **on Sundays** — «yakshanba kunlari», ya'ni har yakshanba. O'zbekchada bu yerda ko'pincha «kuni» so'zi ishlatiladi: **on** Friday — juma **kuni**.
in — oy, yil, fasl va kun qismlari

**in** uzunroq vaqt «ichida» degan ma'noni beradi: oy (**in** June), yil (**in** 1991), fasl (**in** summer / **in** the summer), asr (**in** the 15th century), o'n yillik (**in** the 1990s). Kun qismlari ham **in** bilan: **in the morning**, **in the afternoon**, **in the evening**. Lekin kecha — istisno: **at night**. Agar kun qismidan oldin hafta kuni aytilsa, butun ibora kunga aylanadi va **on** ishlatiladi: **on** Monday morning, **on** Friday night.

rows: tushdan keyin / seshanba kuni tushdan keyin

items.text: It rains a lot here **in** November.
items.translation: Bu yerda noyabr**da** ko'p yomg'ir yog'adi.

items.text: I feel more awake **in** the evening than **in** the morning.

blocks.text: **in** + vaqt miqdori kelajak haqida gapirganda «hozirdan boshlab shuncha vaqt o'tgach» degan ma'noni beradi: **in** five minutes — besh daqiqa**dan keyin**, **in** two weeks — ikki hafta**dan keyin**. O'zbekchadagi «keyin» so'zi sababli ko'pchilik «after five minutes» deydi — kelasi zamonda bu xato. **after** o'tgan voqealarni ketma-ket aytganda ishlatiladi (105-dars).

items.text: The taxi will be here **in** ten minutes.
items.translation: Taksi o'n daqiqa**dan keyin** shu yerda bo'ladi.

items.text: Exams start **in** a month, so I'm studying hard.
items.translation: Imtihonlar bir oy**dan keyin** boshlanadi, shuning uchun qattiq o'qiyapman.

blocks.text: **this**, **next**, **last**, **every** bilan boshlangan vaqt iboralaridan oldin predlog **qo'yilmaydi**: **next** Monday (on next Monday emas), **last** summer, **this** evening, **every** year. **today**, **tomorrow**, **yesterday** ham predlogsiz. O'zbekchada esa «o'tgan yoz**da**», «kelasi hafta**da**» deb qo'shimcha qolaveradi — xato aynan shu yerdan kelib chiqadi.

rows: dam olish kunlari / har dam olish kuni

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari (hammasi bitta `-da` dan): «in Monday» → **on Monday**; «in 5 May» → **on 5 May**; «at the morning» → **in the morning**; «in night» → **at night**; «on next week» → **next week**; «at 2019» → **in 2019**; kelajak haqida «after two hours» → **in two hours**.

Eslab qolish uchun piramida: tepada eng kichik nuqta — **at** (soat), o'rtada — **on** (kun), pastda eng keng qism — **in** (oy, yil, fasl, asr). Vaqt qanchalik «katta» bo'lsa, predlog shunchalik pastda.

Vaqt oralig'i va davomiylik (from ... to, until, since, for) — 104-dars; since / for / ago bilan Present Perfect — 19-dars; before, after, during, while — 105-dars. Joy predloglari in / at / on — 106-dars.

rows: **at** the moment, **at** the end of May

examples.title: **at** + clock time: **at** seven, **at** noon
examples.description: Aniq soat — **at**: at six, at half past eight, at noon, at midnight. O'zbekchada «soat olti**da**».

sentences.text: My alarm goes off **at** six every morning.
sentences.translation: Budilnigim har kuni ertalab soat olti**da** jiringlaydi.

sentences.text: The bank opens **at** nine and closes **at** five.
sentences.translation: Bank soat to'qqiz**da** ochilib, besh**da** yopiladi.

sentences.text: What time does the film start? — **At** half past eight.
sentences.translation: Film soat nechada boshlanadi? — Sakkiz yarim**da**.

sentences.text: We usually have lunch **at** one o'clock.
sentences.translation: Odatda soat bir**da** tushlik qilamiz.

sentences.text: Aziz's flight to London leaves **at** 6.15 tomorrow morning.
sentences.translation: Azizning Londonga reysi ertaga ertalab soat 6:15**da** uchadi.

sentences.text: The pharmacy is closed **at** lunchtime, so come after two.
sentences.translation: Dorixona tushlik payti**da** yopiq, shuning uchun soat ikkidan keyin keling.

sentences.text: Please ring me **at** about seven — I'll be at home then.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, menga soat yettilar**da** qo'ng'iroq qiling — o'shanda uyda bo'laman.

sentences.text: In Tashkent the metro stops running **at** midnight.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda metro yarim tun**da** to'xtaydi.

sentences.text: Madina finished her homework **at** ten and went to bed **at** eleven.
sentences.translation: Madina uy vazifasini soat o'n**da** tugatib, o'n bir**da** uxlagani yotdi.

sentences.text: The meeting started **at** ten, but James only came **at** twenty past.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish soat o'n**da** boshlandi, lekin Jeyms faqat o'ndan yigirma o'tgan**da** keldi.

examples.title: **at night**, **at the weekend**, **at Christmas**
examples.description: Ba'zi turg'un iboralar ham **at** bilan: at night, at the weekend, at Christmas, at the moment, at the same time, at the beginning / end of ...

sentences.text: I can't sleep **at night** when it's too hot.
sentences.translation: Havo juda issiq bo'lsa, **kechasi** uxlay olmayman.

sentences.text: What are you doing **at the weekend**?
sentences.translation: **Dam olish kunlari** nima qilyapsiz?

sentences.text: **At Christmas** many British families eat roast turkey.
sentences.translation: **Rojdestvoda** ko'p ingliz oilalari qovurilgan kurka yeydi.

sentences.text: Sorry, Dilnoza is busy **at the moment** — can she call you back?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Dilnoza **hozir** band — sizga keyinroq qo'ng'iroq qilsinmi?

sentences.text: The two trains left the station **at the same time**.
sentences.translation: Ikki poyezd bekatdan **bir vaqtda** jo'nadi.

sentences.text: We're moving to a bigger flat **at the end of** May.
sentences.translation: May **oxirida** kattaroq kvartiraga ko'chyapmiz.

sentences.text: **At Navruz** our whole family cooks sumalak together.
sentences.translation: **Navro'zda** butun oilamiz birga sumalak pishiradi.

sentences.text: There aren't many buses **at night**, so we took a taxi.
sentences.translation: **Kechasi** avtobus kam bo'ladi, shuning uchun taksiga o'tirdik.

sentences.text: **At the beginning of** the lesson, the teacher checked our homework.
sentences.translation: Dars **boshida** o'qituvchi uy vazifamizni tekshirdi.

sentences.text: Tom works in a hotel, so he's often busy **at the weekend** and free on Mondays.
sentences.translation: Tom mehmonxonada ishlaydi, shuning uchun **dam olish kunlari** ko'pincha band, dushanbalari esa bo'sh.

examples.title: **on** + days and dates: **on** Monday, **on** 5 May
examples.description: Hafta kunlari, sanalar va maxsus kunlar — **on**: on Friday, on 21 March, on my birthday. Har hafta takrorlansa — ko'plik: **on Saturdays**.

sentences.text: I've got an English lesson **on** Tuesday.
sentences.translation: Seshanba **kuni** ingliz tili darsim bor.

sentences.text: My grandmother goes to the market **on** Saturdays.
sentences.translation: Buvim shanba **kunlari** bozorga boradi.

sentences.text: When is your birthday? — It's **on** 14 July.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningiz qachon? — 14-iyul**da**.

sentences.text: Navruz is celebrated **on** 21 March all over Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Navro'z butun O'zbekistonda 21-mart**da** nishonlanadi.

sentences.text: We got married **on** a sunny Saturday in June.
sentences.translation: Biz iyundagi quyoshli shanba **kuni** turmush qurganmiz.

sentences.text: **On** my birthday my friends took me to a restaurant.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kunim**da** do'stlarim meni restoranga olib borishdi.

sentences.text: **On** New Year's Day the streets are very quiet.
sentences.translation: Yangi yil **kuni** ko'chalar juda jim bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Are you free **on** Thursday? — Yes, after four.
sentences.translation: Payshanba **kuni** bo'shmisiz? — Ha, soat to'rtdan keyin.

sentences.text: Sarah was born **on** 3 October 2001 in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Sara 2001-yil 3-oktabr**da** Oksfordda tug'ilgan.

sentences.text: The exam isn't **on** Wednesday, it's **on** Thursday, so we have one more day.
sentences.translation: Imtihon chorshanba **kuni** emas, payshanba **kuni**, demak, yana bir kunimiz bor.

examples.title: **in** + months, years, seasons, centuries
examples.description: Uzunroq davr — **in**: in August, in 2015, in winter, in the 15th century, in the 1990s.

sentences.text: My cousin's wedding is **in** August.
sentences.translation: Amakivachchamning to'yi avgust**da**.

sentences.text: **In** summer it's extremely hot in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Yoz**da** Buxoroda havo juda issiq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Emma started primary school **in** 2015.
sentences.translation: Emma boshlang'ich maktabga 2015-yil**da** borgan.

sentences.text: Ulugh Beg's madrasah in Samarkand was built **in** the fifteenth century.
sentences.translation: Samarqanddagi Ulug'bek madrasasi XV asr**da** qurilgan.

sentences.text: When do students take their final exams? — **In** June.
sentences.translation: Talabalar yakuniy imtihonlarni qachon topshirishadi? — Iyun**da**.

sentences.text: Apples are cheap **in** autumn because there are so many.
sentences.translation: Kuz**da** olma arzon, chunki u juda ko'p bo'ladi.

sentences.text: We're going to visit my uncle in Manchester **in** the spring.
sentences.translation: Bahor**da** Manchesterdagi amakimnikiga bormoqchimiz.

sentences.text: **In** 1991 Uzbekistan became an independent country.
sentences.translation: 1991-yil**da** O'zbekiston mustaqil davlatga aylandi.

sentences.text: The weather in London is usually grey and wet **in** November.
sentences.translation: Noyabr**da** Londonda havo odatda bulutli va yomg'irli bo'ladi.

sentences.text: My parents met **in** the 1990s, and they got married **in** 1998.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam 1990-yillar**da** tanishishgan va 1998-yil**da** turmush qurishgan.

examples.title: **in the morning**, **on Monday morning**, **at night**
examples.description: Kun qismlari — **in the morning / afternoon / evening**, lekin **at night**. Hafta kuni qo'shilsa — **on**: on Monday morning, on Friday night.

sentences.text: I always drink green tea **in the morning**.
sentences.translation: Men doim **ertalab** ko'k choy ichaman.

sentences.text: Bekzod has football practice **in the afternoon**.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning **tushdan keyin** futbol mashg'uloti bor.

sentences.text: **In the evening** the whole family has dinner together.
sentences.translation: **Kechqurun** butun oila birga kechki ovqat qiladi.

sentences.text: The streets are empty **at night**, and it's very quiet.
sentences.translation: **Kechasi** ko'chalar bo'm-bo'sh va juda jim bo'ladi.

sentences.text: What are you doing **on Saturday morning**? — Nothing special.
sentences.translation: **Shanba kuni ertalab** nima qilyapsiz? — Hech narsa.

sentences.text: Madina's sister phoned **on Sunday evening**.
sentences.translation: Madinaning opasi **yakshanba kuni kechqurun** qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: Do you study better **in the morning** or **in the evening**?
sentences.translation: **Ertalab**mi yoki **kechqurun**mi yaxshiroq o'qiysiz?

sentences.text: The baby wakes up three times **at night**, so we're always tired.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq **kechasi** uch marta uyg'onadi, shuning uchun doim charchaganmiz.

sentences.text: **On Sunday afternoon** Tom and his son went fishing at the lake.
sentences.translation: **Yakshanba kuni tushdan keyin** Tom o'g'li bilan ko'lga baliq oviga bordi.

sentences.text: I don't like driving **at night**, so I'll leave early **in the morning**.
sentences.translation: **Kechasi** mashina haydashni yoqtirmayman, shuning uchun **ertalab** erta yo'lga chiqaman.

examples.title: **in** ten minutes: time from now
examples.description: **in** + vaqt miqdori — hozirdan boshlab shuncha vaqt o'tgach: in ten minutes — o'n daqiqa**dan keyin**. Kelajak haqida «after ten minutes» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: The bus will be here **in** five minutes.
sentences.translation: Avtobus besh daqiqa**dan keyin** shu yerda bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Hurry up! The concert starts **in** ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Tezroq! Konsert o'n daqiqa**dan keyin** boshlanadi.

sentences.text: My sister is getting married **in** two weeks.
sentences.translation: Opam ikki hafta**dan keyin** turmushga chiqyapti.

sentences.text: I'm busy now, but I can help you **in** an hour.
sentences.translation: Hozir bandman, lekin bir soat**dan keyin** sizga yordam bera olaman.

sentences.text: Dinner will be ready **in** twenty minutes — go and wash your hands.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat yigirma daqiqa**dan keyin** tayyor bo'ladi — borib qo'lingizni yuving.

sentences.text: When does Aziz finish university? — **In** a year.
sentences.translation: Aziz universitetni qachon tugatadi? — Bir yil**dan keyin**.

sentences.text: **In** three days we're flying to Manchester for a conference.
sentences.translation: Uch kun**dan keyin** konferensiya uchun Manchesterga uchyapmiz.

sentences.text: Can you call back **in** half an hour? The manager is in a meeting.
sentences.translation: Yarim soat**dan keyin** qayta qo'ng'iroq qila olasizmi? Menejer yig'ilishda.

sentences.text: The supermarket closes **in** fifteen minutes, so let's be quick.
sentences.translation: Supermarket o'n besh daqiqa**dan keyin** yopiladi, tezroq bo'laylik.

sentences.text: Mr Brown is away now, but he'll be back **in** a week.
sentences.translation: Janob Braun hozir yo'q, lekin bir hafta**dan keyin** qaytadi.

examples.title: No preposition: **next week**, **last year**, **every day**
examples.description: this, next, last, every, today, tomorrow, yesterday oldidan predlog qo'yilmaydi: **next Monday** («on next Monday» emas), **last summer**. O'zbekchada esa «-da» qolaveradi: o'tgan yoz**da**.

sentences.text: I'm meeting Sarah **next Friday**.
sentences.translation: Sara bilan **kelasi juma** uchrashaman.

sentences.text: We went to Bukhara **last summer**.
sentences.translation: **O'tgan yozda** Buxoroga bordik.

sentences.text: Dilnoza goes swimming **every morning** before work.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **har kuni ertalab** ishdan oldin suzishga boradi.

sentences.text: What are you doing **this evening**?
sentences.translation: **Bugun kechqurun** nima qilyapsiz?

sentences.text: The new shopping centre opened **last month**.
sentences.translation: Yangi savdo markazi **o'tgan oy** ochildi.

sentences.text: **This year** my little brother starts school.
sentences.translation: **Bu yil** ukam maktabga boradi.

sentences.text: Is the test **tomorrow** or **next week**?
sentences.translation: Test **ertagami** yoki **kelasi haftadami**?

sentences.text: **On Monday** I'm free, but **next Monday** I'm working.
sentences.translation: **Bu dushanba** bo'shman, lekin **kelasi dushanba** ishlayman.

sentences.text: James phoned **yesterday afternoon**, but I was out.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **kecha tushdan keyin** qo'ng'iroq qildi, lekin men uyda yo'q edim.

sentences.text: **Every year** thousands of tourists visit Samarkand, and **this year** there are even more.
sentences.translation: **Har yili** minglab sayyohlar Samarqandga keladi, **bu yil** esa ular yanada ko'p.

examples.title: When ...? — **At** / **On** / **In** ...
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: «When?» va «What time?» savollariga javob — at, on, in yoki predlogsiz.

sentences.text: When is the concert? — It's **on** Saturday **at** seven.
sentences.translation: Konsert qachon? — Shanba **kuni** soat yetti**da**.

sentences.text: Were you born **in** winter? — No, **in** spring, **on** 12 April.
sentences.translation: Qish**da** tug'ilganmisiz? — Yo'q, bahor**da**, 12-aprel**da**.

sentences.text: What time do you usually get up? — **At** about seven, but later **at the weekend**.
sentences.translation: Odatda soat nechada turasiz? — Soat yettilar**da**, **dam olish kunlari** esa kechroq.

sentences.text: In Uzbekistan the school year ends **in** May and starts again **on** 2 September.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda o'quv yili may**da** tugab, 2-sentabr**da** yana boshlanadi.

sentences.text: Have you got an appointment? — Yes, **on** Thursday morning **at** nine.
sentences.translation: Navbatga yozilganmisiz? — Ha, **payshanba kuni ertalab** soat to'qqiz**da**.

sentences.text: When did your family move to Tashkent? — **In** 2010, when I was five.
sentences.translation: Oilangiz Toshkentga qachon ko'chib kelgan? — 2010-yil**da**, men besh yoshligimda.

sentences.text: Is the bakery open **on** Sundays? — Yes, but only **in** the morning.
sentences.translation: Novvoyxona yakshanba **kunlari** ochiqmi? — Ha, lekin faqat **ertalab**.

sentences.text: When will the pizza arrive? — **In** about twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Pitsa qachon keladi? — Taxminan yigirma daqiqa**dan keyin**.

sentences.text: Did you see Emma **at** Christmas? — No, I saw her **in** January.
sentences.translation: Emmani **Rojdestvoda** ko'rdingizmi? — Yo'q, uni yanvar**da** ko'rdim.

sentences.text: How often do you visit your grandparents? — **Every** weekend, usually **on** Sunday afternoon.
sentences.translation: Bobo-buvingiznikiga qanchalik tez-tez borasiz? — **Har** dam olish kuni, odatda yakshanba **kuni tushdan keyin**.
